newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg seen nudging up to 2.70 marks, $1.60.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg seen nudging up to 2.70 marks, $1.60.

text.p: Sterling looks set for a brief bounce against the mark to test 2.70 today, although the big picture is not very bullish and looks extremely volatile, technical analysts said.
The test of 2.70, which blocked sterling/mark's drop last week and its recovery this week, will be the key to whether it can break out of this week's bearish trend, they said.

"Overall I think sterling/mark's current move is a corrective bounce bofore resuming another drop back towards 2.63 as part of much bigger overall correction to the upmove," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking.
A breach of this level would set sterling/mark's next goal at a congestion area of 2.7020-30 and then this week's high of 2.7165, analysts said.
Failure to do so would open the way for a slide to 2.6755-65, where sterling had struggled in early February before starting its climb to a 53-month high of 2.7735, they said.
Cable is expected to consolidate with a firm bias, although with any big rise above $1.60 seen as unlikely.
"Cable has an area of congestion at $1.6010-30 and I'd be surprised if we can manage to break above that, as we haven't been able to do it for quite some time," Ostwald said.
